scientific.integrity: Exhaustive simplex enumeration and a globally checked acyclic face-poset matching prove the claim; matrix-forest and three-field homology calculations independently cross-check the finite data.
scientific.limitations: Exact finite result for the single house graph; no family theorem is claimed. Originality is relative to inspected literature and searches.

title: The house-graph Morse complex is a wedge of five 3-spheres
